reviewed_by: Static review against retained Binary Ninja and Radare2 evidence and the current native body
scope: Exact function entry, single-block control flow, context-field store and EAX return. Differential scope is limited to recorded angr VEX cases.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 identify the retail function at 0x004028A0; angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry. The current address-bound implementation is Flow_SetState.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail consumes one 32-bit value argument; the candidate takes one uint32_t argument.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail stores at context offset +0x2C with no scaling or additional literal transformation.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The candidate stores the supplied 32-bit value into the context field at +0x2C through DAT_00567C8C, as in the retail instruction evidence.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail and candidate perform the context field store and make no calls; the differential compared the context bytes and global pointer state.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Single path returns the stored value in EAX; eight recorded angr VEX cases matched return and memory state.

limitations: The source-level context pointer type is not established by retail; the pointer layout and +0x2C offset are observed.
Differential execution used angr VEX rather than a live IGI/Frida process.
